r1.current_hypothesis: Schwartz value theory: structure = circular motivational continuum; PVQ-RR scoring; human ranking benchmark.
r1.key_evidence: Recalled: PVQ-RR has 57 items, 3 per value, measuring 19 refined values that collapse to 10 classic basic values (SelfDirection, Stimulation, Hedonism, Achievement, Power, Security, Conformity, Tradition, Benevolence, Universalism) on two bipolar axes: Openness-to-change vs Conservation, Self-enhancement vs Self-transcendence. Structure = a CIRCLE/circumplex: adjacent values correlate +, opposite values -. (1) RANKING benchmark: pan-cultural hierarchy is stable — high: Benevolence, SelfDirection, Universalism; mid: Security, Conformity, Hedonism, Achievement; low: Stimulation, Tradition, Power (Power usually lowest, Benevolence highest). (2) CORRELATION benchmark: order of values around the circle (via MDS) should match the theoretical circle; instruction eval = procrustes-align MDS of value locations to the human benchmark and sum squared diffs. Scoring: v_i = mean of 3 items, minus within-conversation grand mean (center to remove scale-use bias).
r1.main_risk: Exact human ranking varies by sample/culture; I use the widely-replicated pan-cultural order. Circular structure needs MANY respondents to estimate inter-value correlations.
r1.next_action: Use this benchmark to test ranking (q2) and prompt-dependence (q3).
